items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: No, it was a Western fellow in Washington, D.C., kept a half a million standing in the banks.

ctx.x: Who was the backer? Was that Irving Mills?
No, it was a Western fellow in Washington, D.C., kept a half a million standing in the banks. Money was no problem. We bought that All-American sleeper and then I
bought another sleeper bus for the other band, had it made. That's the kind of money, man, it was. We all know Arlington Cemetery. He gave that land to the government and a lot of things like that.
